name: The Twelve Apostles Hotel & Spa
positioning: Red Carnation hotel built into the mountainside on the conservation-area coastal road between Camps Bay and Llandudno, with fynbos-clad mountain on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet ocean-and-mountain setting outside central Cape Town, with a complimentary shuttle to the V&A Waterfront
Couples looking for sunset dining, a spa and richly decorated rooms

facts.text: In March 2002 the hotel became part of the family-owned Red Carnation Hotels and was renamed The Twelve Apostles Hotel and Spa.
In 1929 Jack van Breda designed the original house in the style of Sir Herbert Baker, with two big white frontal gables and a thatched roof.
Alien plant species around the hotel were removed and extensive indigenous gardens were cultivated.
The coastal road between Camps Bay and Llandudno is an undeveloped conservation area, with fynbos-clad mountainside on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other.
The hotel is named after the Twelve Apostles mountain range, which runs parallel to the coast from Camps Bay to Llandudno.
The hotel is built into the contours of the mountainside on a relatively small footprint.
Every room's layout and decoration is slightly different, with matching wallpaper and fabrics, elegant mirrors and original art.
The mountain-facing cafe specializes in sushi and seafood.
The Leopard Bar has terrace tables for sundowner cocktails.
The spa is tucked below the hotel and has a loyal local following.
The hotel runs a complimentary all-day shuttle to the V&A Waterfront, about a 20-minute drive away.

highlights.text: The rooms were designed and decorated by the owners, the Tollmans, in a flamboyant, old-school glamour style.
Experiences include helicopter flights, mountain walks, High Tea by the Sea and treatments in an outdoor mountain spa gazebo.
The hotel has a 16-seat cinema with drinks, popcorn and candy.
Azure restaurant has blue and white interiors and is suited to watching the sun set.
Breakfast includes complimentary freshly shucked oysters and bubbly.

considerations.text: The closest restaurants outside the hotel are 15 minutes away by car in Camps Bay.
Early morning traffic on the coastal road may disturb light sleepers.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
